moments.text: Colour camera looking down on the stern and superstructure of a large ship pushing through blue sea, white wake behind it.
Between brief flashes, a wider view shows the ship small near the crosshair, trailing its wake.
The view switches to blue water under a bright band at the top. A pale patch stays fixed on screen at the lower left.
An orange-white glare grows at the top of the frame and spreads over the upper left, then the view moves off it.
Grey-scale view inside a rounded frame with grey borders, crosshair at centre.
A small bright spot enters at the right side of the picture and crosses diagonally down-left past the crosshair to the left edge. About 2 s.
The spot comes back in at the left; the sensor follows it as it drifts toward the crosshair and then up and right.
After a white flash, the picture turns blue again and widens to fill the frame.
Zoomed out over rippled sea, a white spot with a faint tail crosses from the lower right past the crosshair to the upper left in about 1 s.
A bright white spot with a short faint tail below it enters at the left and settles below and right of the crosshair.
On darker blue-green water the spot shows as a soft pale blob, drifting around the crosshair as the view zooms in and out.
The picture switches to grey-scale for about 4 s, showing ground with dark lines, then returns to colour.
Back in colour, a faint pale speck sits near the crosshair until the clip ends.
